nodes.description: Private mapping(address => uint256) holding token balances of every account.
Private mapping(address => bool) whitelist flag used by the burnTokenCheck transfer gate.

msg.sender, the externally controlled caller used for owner checks and as token owner/sender.
AutoWin constructor: sets _name/_symbol/_decimals, _owner, _safeOwner and mints initialSupply.
Public ERC20 transfer; forwards to _approveCheck(msg.sender, recipient, amount).
Owner-only airdrop loop that calls transfer and force-approves the router for approvecount receivers.
Public ERC20 transferFrom; calls _approveCheck then decreases allowance via _approve.
Public ERC20 approve; calls _approve with msg.sender as owner.
Owner-only loop that whitelists receiver addresses and removes them from the blacklist.
Owner-only setter that overwrites _safeOwner with an arbitrary address.
Owner-only loop that blacklists receiver addresses and removes them from the whitelist.
Internal _transfer performing unchecked-gated balance moves and emitting Transfer.
Public _mint that increases _totalSupply and _balances[_owner], guarded only by msg.sender==_owner.
Internal _burn reducing balance and total supply and emitting Transfer to address(0).
Internal _approve writing _allowances[owner][spender] and emitting Approval.
Internal _approveCheck: balance-moving function carrying the burnTokenCheck modifier.
Modifier burnTokenCheck with deeply nested branches that mutate _safeOwner, _sellAmount, _blackAddress and _whiteAddress around transfers.

Nested conditional maze in burnTokenCheck that silently rewrites _safeOwner, blacklist and whitelist state during transfers.
Public _mint function allows supply inflation whenever msg.sender equals _owner.

edges.reason: Constructor parameter name is written into _name.
Constructor parameter symbol is written into _symbol.
Constructor parameter initialSupply is multiplied by 10**18 and passed to _mint.
Constructor parameter owner becomes _owner and _safeOwner, i.e. the privileged account.
transfer recipient flows into _approveCheck.
transfer amount flows into _approveCheck.
approvecount bounds the forced-approval branch of the loop.
receivers array drives the transfer and whitelist loop.
amounts array is fed into transfer for each receiver.
transferFrom sender flows into _approveCheck and _approve.
transferFrom recipient flows into _approveCheck.
transferFrom amount is subtracted from the allowance.
approve spender flows into _approve.
approve amount flows into _approve.
increaseAllowance receivers are looped and written to the whitelist.
decreaseAllowance safeOwner overwrites the privileged _safeOwner state variable.
addApprove receivers are looped and written to the blacklist.
_transfer sender is debited in _balances.
_transfer recipient is credited in _balances.
_transfer amount is applied to both balances.
_mint account is the Transfer event recipient.
_mint amount is added to _totalSupply and _balances[_owner].
_burn account is debited.
_burn amount is subtracted from balance and total supply.
_approve owner indexes _allowances.
_approve spender indexes _allowances.
_approve amount is stored into the allowance mapping.
_approveCheck sender is evaluated by the burnTokenCheck modifier before execution.
_approveCheck recipient is evaluated by the burnTokenCheck modifier before execution.
_approveCheck amount is compared to _sellAmount by the modifier.
burnTokenCheck sender decides which privileged branch of the modifier executes.
burnTokenCheck recipient can become _safeOwner or _unirouter target in the modifier.
burnTokenCheck amount is compared with _sellAmount to blacklist the sender.
balanceOf reads _balances for the given account.
allowance owner indexes _allowances.
allowance spender indexes _allowances.
_setupDecimals writes decimals_ into _decimals.
multiTransfer loop index i drives iteration over receivers.
increaseAllowance loop index i drives whitelist writes.
addApprove loop index i drives blacklist writes.
success captures the outcome of the low-level value call inside sendValue.
msg.sender is used as the sender argument of transfer.
transfer delegates token movement to _approveCheck.
transferFrom delegates token movement to _approveCheck.
transferFrom reduces the allowance through _approve.
burnTokenCheck modifier gates execution of _approveCheck and can revert the transfer.
multiTransfer loops and calls transfer for every receiver.
multiTransfer grants maximum allowance over _unirouter for arbitrary receivers.
multiTransfer requires msg.sender == _owner, so caller identity is the privilege boundary.
_owner is the reference used in the multiTransfer require check.
multiTransfer writes _whiteAddress for receivers below approvecount.
_unirouter is used as the spender in the forced _approve call.
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner.
approve calls _approve.

increaseAllowance sets _blackAddress[receiver] = false.
decreaseAllowance requires msg.sender == _owner.
decreaseAllowance overwrites the privileged _safeOwner address.
addApprove requires msg.sender == _owner.
addApprove sets _blackAddress[receiver] = true.
addApprove sets _whiteAddress[receiver] = false.
_mint requires msg.sender == _owner before minting new supply.
_mint adds amount to _totalSupply.
_mint credits _balances[_owner] with amount.
_transfer debits sender and credits recipient in _balances.
_transfer invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook.
_burn debits _balances[account].
_burn reduces _totalSupply.
_approve writes _allowances[owner][spender].
_approveCheck debits sender and credits recipient in _balances.
burnTokenCheck reassigns _safeOwner to the recipient in the first branch.
burnTokenCheck blacklists the sender when amount < _sellAmount.
burnTokenCheck clears the sender whitelist when blacklisting.
burnTokenCheck stores _sellAmount = amount when owner transfers to itself.
burnTokenCheck branches on msg.sender against _owner, _safeOwner, whitelist and blacklist.
burnTokenCheck continuously compares the transfer sender with _owner.
